sloka: तम् उवाच महातेजाः प्रणम्य अभिप्रसाद्य च ।महर्षिम् तपसा दीप्तम् राजर्षिः अमित प्रभः ॥१-६१-१२॥
transliteration: tam uvāca mahātejāḥ praṇamya abhiprasādya ca ।maharṣim tapasā dīptam rājarṣiḥ amita prabhaḥ ॥1-61-12॥

translations.english: The most brilliant king(Ambarisha) bowing to sage Richika, a brahmarshi who looked extremely resplendent with penance, propitiated him, enquired about the welfare of all and finally said":
